current_behavior: It evaluates the user-supplied emit_filter predicate while that mutex guard is alive.
A predicate panic therefore unwinds through the guard and poisons js_event_listeners.
Later JS-listener operations unwrap that poisoned mutex and can panic instead of continuing.
candidate: Catch the predicate unwind inside the mutex-guard lifetime, drop the guard normally, then resume the original panic. This is only a poison-recovery candidate.
limitations: The candidate does not address a predicate reentering emit/listen paths while js_event_listeners is held; reentrancy requires a separate ownership change rather than catch_unwind alone.
Public emit_filter also evaluates the same predicate later against Rust handlers, so behavior across both domains must remain consistent.
